parts.text: I should really do the work now; otherwise, I'll have twice as much to do later on. I've seen that film on several occasions, but never on the big screen. Whatever else happens during the day, I always keep to a set time for getting up, eating and going to bed, and so I always feel healthy. In a civilized society, people show respect to others. It is said that one should always practice what one preaches.
